scenes.title: An Indoor Paint Shop
scenes.summary: On rainy Monday morning, Davide sets up cross-breeze airflow in the wide back hallway so Chiara and Bruno can paint the four shutters indoors.

scenes.title: Green Glasses
scenes.summary: Cesare insists on painting one shutter slat to help, immediately getting a streak of green paint on the reading glasses perched on his forehead.

scenes.title: Middle D Sings Again
scenes.summary: On Tuesday morning, Bruno reseats the tiny brass pin and tunes the middle strings while Lucia tests middle D on the walnut piano.

scenes.title: Hanging the Green Shutters
scenes.summary: In Tuesday's bright afternoon sun, Bruno, Davide, and Chiara hang the freshly painted green shutters around Room 9's arched glass.

scenes.title: The Welcome Sign
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Chiara designs a simple welcome sign and café menu card that Cesare and Lucia check line by line.

scenes.title: Watch the Low Stool
scenes.summary: In the Tuesday evening kitchen, Giulia reaches for the big copper teapot on the high shelf and twists her right ankle stepping off the low wooden stool.

scenes.title: Ice, Pillows, and Orders
scenes.summary: Chiara and Paolo prop Giulia's ankle comfortably on two pillows while Giulia writes out step-by-step Wednesday baking jobs for the whole crew.

scenes.title: One Jar Is Salt
scenes.summary: Late Tuesday night while tidying the counter for dawn baking, Cesare refills two unlabeled white ceramic jars—leaving Chiara and Bruno unsure which is sugar and which is salt.
